description: This file is a Bash script used to generate a FIT (Flattened Image Tree) image for U-Boot firmware. It creates a .its source file based on user inputs and various image components such as kernel, device tree blobs, initrd, rootfs, and overlays, which can be compiled into an .itb image for booting.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for running the script.

methods.name: check_required_params
methods.description: Validates that all required parameters are provided; otherwise, it shows an error and usage info.
